cases.title: 2-D: a free point told to divide AB 1:2 sits a third of the way along
cases.lookFor: A segment AB is drawn with D on it, one third of the way from A to B (AD is half of DB). Both rows are green.
cases.before: Green, but D sat almost on A (AD:DB ≈ 0.14): the ratio was dropped.

cases.title: 2-D: the same ratio said in prose
cases.lookFor: D is on segment AB, one third of the way from A to B. Every row is green.
cases.before: D stayed roughly where it was first drawn; the ratio was dropped, and the row was green.

cases.title: REFUSAL 2-D: a midpoint cannot also divide AB 1:2
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused, and the message names the ratio (it mentions AD and DB, or 1:2). The line stays in the box, and D stays at the midpoint of AB.
cases.before: Accepted green, with D left at the midpoint: the figure claimed a 1:2 split that does not hold.

cases.title: 2-D: a point already on AB takes the ratio
cases.lookFor: D is on side AB, one third of the way from A to B. Every row is green.
cases.before: D kept sliding freely on AB; the ratio was dropped, and the row was green.

cases.title: 2-D: the bisector's foot divides BC 1:2, and the triangle follows
cases.lookFor: AD is drawn from A to D on BC, with D one third of the way from B to C (BD is half of DC). The triangle reshapes to make that true (AB is half of AC). Every row is green.
cases.before: D stayed at the bisector's original foot; the ratio was dropped, and the row was green.

cases.title: 2-D control: a point on AB with no ratio still slides
cases.lookFor: D is on AB. Pressing «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves D to a different spot along AB.

cases.title: 2-D: the crossing of lines AB and CD keeps the quadrilateral convex
lines: M is the intersection of lines AB and CD
cases.lookFor: ABCD stays an ordinary (convex, non-crossed) quadrilateral. M lies outside it, where the extensions of AB and DC meet, with dashed extensions to M.
cases.before: The quadrilateral was re-seated into a crossed (bow-tie) shape so that M sat inside both sides.

cases.title: 2-D: the crossing of the rays AB and CD
lines: M נקודת החיתוך של הקרניים AB ו-CD
cases.lookFor: ABCD stays an ordinary (convex, non-crossed) quadrilateral, and M is drawn outside it, on the extension of AB.
cases.before: The quadrilateral was re-seated into a crossed (bow-tie) shape so that M sat inside both sides.

cases.title: 2-D: the rays AB and CD meet at M (the verb frame)
lines: הקרניים AB ו-CD נחתכים בנקודה M
cases.lookFor: ABCD stays an ordinary (convex, non-crossed) quadrilateral, and M is drawn outside it, on the extension of AB.
cases.before: The quadrilateral was re-seated into a crossed (bow-tie) shape so that M sat inside both sides.

cases.title: 2-D control: «הישרים» reads as lines, as before
lines: M נקודת החיתוך של הישרים AB ו-CD
cases.lookFor: ABCD stays an ordinary (convex, non-crossed) quadrilateral, and M is drawn outside it, where the extensions of AB and DC meet.

cases.title: 2-D control: «הקטעים» still means the segments themselves
lines: M נקודת החיתוך של הקטעים AB ו-CD
cases.lookFor: Unchanged from before this round: M is held inside both segments, so the quadrilateral is drawn crossed (AB and DC cross at M), with the amber note «לא נמצאה תצורה שמקיימת את כל הדרישות יחד…».

cases.title: Analytic: the locus of C in winter 2024 is drawn as an unnamed curve
lines: שיעור ה-x של הקדקוד B הוא -2
הנקודה M היא אמצע הצלע BC
expect: עקומה (הכלי עדיין לא מזהה את סוגה)
cases.lookFor: The answer reads «המקום הגיאומטרי של C = עקומה (הכלי עדיין לא מזהה את סוגה)», and a dashed curve (a sideways parabola opening right, through C) is drawn. No equation is printed. (Reached through the point's locus chip, #2673.)
cases.before: No answer, and nothing was drawn.

after.say: press «הצג מקום גאומטרי» on the row of C

cases.title: Analytic: the locus of M in the same exam is still named
lines: שיעור ה-x של הקדקוד B הוא -2
הנקודה M היא אמצע הצלע BC
cases.lookFor: The answer names a parabola: «פרבולה · y² = 8x». (Reached through the point's locus chip, #2673.)

after.say: press «הצג מקום גאומטרי» on the row of M

cases.title: Analytic: the locus of B in the same exam is still named
lines: שיעור ה-x של הקדקוד B הוא -2
הנקודה M היא אמצע הצלע BC
cases.lookFor: The answer names a line: «ישר · x + 2 = 0». (Reached through the point's locus chip, #2673.)

after.say: press «הצג מקום גאומטרי» on the row of B

cases.title: Analytic: a parabola on the y-axis is drawn, unnamed
expect: עקומה (הכלי עדיין לא מזהה את סוגה)
cases.lookFor: The answer reads «עקומה (הכלי עדיין לא מזהה את סוגה)», and an upward parabola through the origin is drawn dashed. (Reached through the point's locus chip, #2673.)
cases.before: No answer, and nothing was drawn.

after.say: press «הצג מקום גאומטרי» on the row of X

cases.title: Analytic: PA + PB = 10 is drawn, unnamed
expect: עקומה (הכלי עדיין לא מזהה את סוגה)
cases.lookFor: The answer reads «עקומה (הכלי עדיין לא מזהה את סוגה)», and an ellipse around A and B (centre (4,0)) is drawn dashed. (Reached through the point's locus chip, #2673.)
cases.before: No answer, and nothing was drawn.

after.say: press «הצג מקום גאומטרי» on the row of P

cases.title: Analytic control: a shifted circle is still named with its equation
cases.lookFor: The answer names a circle: «מעגל · (x − 2)² + (y − 1)² = 1²». (Reached through the point's locus chip, #2673.)

after.say: press «הצג מקום גאומטרי» on the row of M

cases.title: Analytic control: a point that does not move draws no curve
lines: שיעור ה-x של הקדקוד B הוא -a
הנקודה M היא אמצע הצלע BC
expectAbsent: עקומה (הכלי עדיין לא מזהה את סוגה)
cases.lookFor: A does not move, so its row has no «הצג מקום גאומטרי» chip and no curve is drawn for A.

cases.title: REFUSAL analytic: a shifted parabola typed as a given is still refused
cases.lookFor: The line is refused with «המשפט מובן, אך אינו נתמך בכלי הזה…»; nothing is drawn.

cases.title: Analytic: «ישר l1 עובר דרך A ומאונך לציר x», and the locus of the crossing P
lines: ישר l1 עובר דרך A ומאונך לציר x
ישר l2 עובר דרך B ומאונך לציר y
P נקודת החיתוך של l1 ו-l2
cases.lookFor: Every line is accepted. l1 is a vertical line through A, l2 a horizontal line through B, and P is drawn where they cross. (Reached through the point's locus chip, #2673.)
cases.before: «ישר l1 עובר דרך A ומאונך לציר x» was refused as not understood.

after.say: press «הצג מקום גאומטרי» on the row of P

cases.title: Analytic: the relation first, then «ועובר דרך A»
lines: l1 מאונך לציר ה-x ועובר דרך A
cases.lookFor: The line is accepted, and l1 is drawn as the vertical line x = 1 through A.

cases.title: Analytic: the point last, «ישר l1 מאונך לציר ה-x דרך A»
lines: ישר l1 מאונך לציר ה-x דרך A
cases.lookFor: The line is accepted, and l1 is drawn as the vertical line x = 1 through A.

cases.title: REFUSAL analytic control: an existing l1 is never re-created by the relation-first order
lines: l1 מאונך לציר ה-x ועובר דרך A
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused with «השם הזה כבר תפוס בשרטוט — הוא ישר…», and l1 stays the line y = 2x + 1.

cases.title: Analytic: an AI answer that turns √2 into 2 is refused, naming √2
lines: אורך הקטע AB שווה בדיוק ל-√2
cases.lookFor: The sentence goes to the AI lane (mocked here to answer «AB = 2»). That answer is refused, naming the student's own value: «הבנתי רק חלקית — לא הצלחתי למקם את √2…». AB gets no length; the triangle is unchanged.
cases.before: The AI's «AB = 2» was committed as if faithful: AB drawn with length 2.

cases.title: Analytic guard: an AI answer that writes radius √2 as r² = 2 is accepted
cases.lookFor: The sentence goes to the AI lane (mocked here to answer «(x-1)^2 + (y-2)^2 = 2»). The answer is accepted: a circle centred at (1,2) is drawn (the centre is labelled «(1, 2)»), and the panel reads (x − 1)² + (y − 2)² = 2 with r = √2.

cases.title: Analytic: the circumcircle after the incircle is a second circle
cases.lookFor: Two circles are drawn: a small one inside the triangle touching its sides, and a large one through A, B and C. The equations panel lists both, «○ABC» and «⊙ABC».
cases.before: The circumcircle line was refused as contradicting the incircle.

cases.title: Analytic: the same with «משולש ABC חסום במעגל»
cases.lookFor: Two circles are drawn, the incircle and a circle through A, B and C; the equations panel lists «○ABC» and «⊙ABC».
cases.before: The last line was refused as contradicting the incircle.

cases.title: Analytic: a second unnamed circumcircle, through A, B and C
cases.lookFor: Two circles are drawn: one through A, B, E and D, and a second through A, B and C. The equations panel lists «⊙ABE» and «⊙ABC».
cases.before: The last line collapsed the figure onto the first circle instead of drawing a second one.

cases.title: Analytic: then the arc's new letter O names that second circle
lines: F אמצע הקשת BC במעגל O
cases.lookFor: Still two circles, no third. O is drawn at the centre of the circle through A, B and C, and F sits on that circle, midway along arc BC.
cases.before: The arc line drew a new, third circle O instead of naming the one through B and C.

cases.title: Analytic: one circle, and the arc's O names it
lines: F אמצע הקשת BC במעגל O
cases.lookFor: One circle only, through A, B and C. O is drawn at its centre, and F on it midway along arc BC.
cases.before: The arc line drew a second circle O beside the circumcircle.

cases.title: Analytic: a triangle drawn beside circle O, then inscribed, gets its own circle
cases.lookFor: Circle O stays where it was. A second circle is drawn through A, B and C, and the triangle does not jump onto circle O. Is that what a student means by «חסום במעגל» here?
cases.before: The triangle was moved onto circle O.

cases.title: Analytic control: a new triangle inscribed in circle O goes on O
cases.lookFor: One circle only: A, B and C are drawn on circle O.

cases.title: REFUSAL analytic control: two circles through B and C, the arc asks which
lines: F אמצע הקשת BC במעגל O
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused, saying there is more than one such circle (the circle ABC and the circle BCD) and asking the student to write its name.

cases.title: Analytic: a median from A, then «D אמצע BC», is one point D
cases.lookFor: One point at the middle of BC, labelled D; the median runs from A to D. No M, and no «… נפלו על אותה נקודה» notice.
cases.before: Two letters, M and D, on the same point, with a notice.

cases.title: Analytic: an altitude's foot named by «AD גובה»
cases.lookFor: One foot of the altitude from A, labelled D, with its right-angle mark. The tool's own letter is gone, and there is no «נפלו על אותה נקודה» notice.
cases.before: The tool's letter and D both sat on the foot.

cases.title: Analytic: a typed M keeps both M and D, with the notice
cases.lookFor: Both M and D are listed, and the notice «M ו-D נפלו על אותה נקודה.» shows: the student typed M, so it is theirs.

cases.title: 3-D: a triangle's area on an empty canvas
cases.lookFor: The line is accepted. Triangle ABC is drawn, and the notice says A, B, C were created.

cases.title: 3-D: AB parallel to the plane ACD on an empty canvas
cases.lookFor: The line is accepted, the points A, B, C, D are created and drawn, and AB runs parallel to plane ACD.

cases.title: 3-D: ∠SAB = ∠SAD on an empty canvas
cases.lookFor: The line is accepted; S, A, B and D are created and drawn.

cases.title: REFUSAL 3-D: parallel, then perpendicular, contradict
cases.lookFor: The second line is refused with «הנתונים סותרים זה את זה — אין גוף שמקיים את «AB ⊥ ACD» יחד עם «AB∥ACD»». The first line stays.
cases.before: The first line was already refused «point-not-determined».

cases.title: 3-D: AB = BC on an empty canvas
cases.lookFor: The line is accepted, and A, B, C are created and drawn.

cases.title: 3-D: AB ⊥ AC on an empty canvas
cases.lookFor: The line is accepted, and A, B, C are created and drawn, with a right angle at A.

cases.title: 3-D control: a point on a cube's edge still slides
cases.lookFor: E is on edge AB of the cube; «הציגו תצורה אחרת» redraws the figure.

cases.title: 3-D: the diagonals of face ABCD meet at O on an empty canvas
lines: O מפגש האלכסונים של הפאה ABCD
cases.lookFor: A flat quadrilateral ABCD is drawn with O inside it where the diagonals cross; the notice names A, B, C, D as created.

cases.title: 3-D: ℓ, the line where planes BC'D and BCC'B' cross
lines: ℓ ישר החיתוך בין המישור BC'D ובין המישור BCC'B'
cases.lookFor: The line is accepted; the five points are created and the crossing line ℓ is drawn.

cases.title: 3-D: BE, the projection of TB on the plane ABCD
lines: BE היטל הישר TB על המישור ABCD
cases.lookFor: The line is accepted: T, B, A, C, D are created, and E is drawn as the foot of T's projection on plane ABCD.

cases.title: 3-D: the diagonals of the quadrilateral ABCD meet at O
lines: O מפגש האלכסונים של המרובע ABCD
cases.lookFor: A flat quadrilateral ABCD is drawn with O where its diagonals cross.

cases.title: 3-D: E on the plane ABCD on an empty canvas
cases.lookFor: The line is accepted; A, B, C, D are created in one plane, and E is drawn on it.

cases.title: 3-D: a cube, then E on the plane ABCX, creates X in that face's plane
cases.lookFor: The line is accepted. X is created on the cube's base plane (the plane through A, B, C), the plane ABCX is shaded, and E sits on it. A notice names X with a ✕ to undo it, in case X was a typo. Is creating X the right answer here, or should a likely typo be refused?
cases.before: Refused «not-coplanar» (X was created off the plane).

cases.title: REFUSAL 3-D: four stated points that are not in one plane
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused with «הנקודות של מישור ABCD אינן קובעות מישור יחיד — בדקו את הנתונים». No point moves.

cases.title: 3-D: a point on the circumcircle rides it
cases.lookFor: D is drawn on the circle through A, B, C; «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves it to other spots on the circle.

cases.title: 3-D: a point on the incircle rides it
cases.lookFor: D is drawn on the incircle of ABC.

cases.title: 3-D: an existing letter moves onto the circle, and its midpoint follows
cases.lookFor: D moves onto the circle, and M stays the midpoint of AD.

cases.title: REFUSAL 3-D: a cube vertex off the circle is not moved onto it
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused («A' אינה על הישר…»), and the cube does not change.

cases.title: 3-D: AE = 1 drives a point on a cube face's circle
cases.lookFor: E is drawn on the circle through A, B, C on the cube's base, at distance 1 from A.
cases.before: «E על המעגל» was refused «E אינה על הישר».

cases.title: REFUSAL 3-D control: «D על המעגל» on an empty canvas is unchanged
cases.lookFor: Refused: no circle is defined yet. (Its wording names an internal «circle»; that is #2611's, filed.)

cases.title: 3-D: d ⊥ ℓ1 and d ⊥ ℓ2, one given per row
cases.lookFor: Every row is accepted, and the three lines are drawn with d perpendicular to both.
cases.before: «d מאונך ל-ℓ1» was refused «הווקטור «d» לא הוגדר».

cases.title: 3-D: the reversed spelling «ℓ1 מאונך ל-d»
cases.lookFor: The row is accepted, and d and ℓ1 are drawn perpendicular.

cases.title: 3-D: a line d perpendicular to the plane ABC of a cube
cases.lookFor: The row is accepted, and d is drawn vertical, parallel to the cube's vertical edges; the relations panel lists d ⊥ AB, BC, … and d ⊥ ABC.

cases.title: 3-D: the angle between lines u and v is 60°
cases.lookFor: The row is accepted, and u and v are drawn with a 60° angle between them.

cases.title: 3-D: «הישרים d ו-ℓ1 מאונכים»
cases.lookFor: The row is accepted, and d and ℓ1 are drawn perpendicular.

cases.title: 3-D: «הישרים d ו-ℓ1 מצטלבים»
cases.lookFor: The row is accepted: d and ℓ1 are skew lines.

cases.title: REFUSAL 3-D: a letter d never declared is still refused
cases.lookFor: The second line is refused «הווקטור «d» לא הוגדר…»: nothing called d exists yet.

cases.title: REFUSAL 3-D control: a declared vector u keeps the vector reading
cases.lookFor: «u ⊥ ℓ1» is read as the vector u, not a line: it is refused as the tool's limit «…עם הווקטור החופשי u…».
